_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The drawer shows running and total subagent counts independently. The test harness has already stubbed the server's conversation list and cut off its live update stream, so there is nothing to set up, intercept or check about that (do not look at the API): the drawer (".drawer") shows the conversations the test names, as rows [data-conversation-id="<id>"] whose title (".conversation-title") is their slug, which is their id (drafts have none), and whose preview is "Preview". "active-parent" has 3 subagents: "active-child" (working, one background job), "waiting-child" (idle, two background jobs) and "active-idle-child". "idle-parent" has 2 idle subagents. Call "settle-active-child" makes active-child idle with no jobs, and call "settle-waiting-child" leaves waiting-child with no jobs, in the server's list. "The active badge" is "[data-conversation-id=\"active-parent\"] .subagent-count-badge" and "the idle badge" is "[data-conversation-id=\"idle-parent\"] .subagent-count-badge". To "reload" the page, use the reload action. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. The active badge's text contains "2/3", and its data-testid "subagent-badge-running" element is visible. 3. The idle badge's trimmed text is exactly "2" and it has no data-testid "subagent-badge-running" element. 4. Call "settle-active-child", then reload. 5. The active badge's text should contain "1/3" and its data-testid "subagent-badge-running" element is visible. 6. Call "settle-waiting-child", then reload. 7. The active badge's trimmed text should be exactly "3", and it has no data-testid "subagent-badge-running" element.
